title: Physics-inspired Generative AI models via real hardware-based noisy quantum diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2505.22193v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum Diffusion Models (QDMs) are an emerging paradigm in Generative AI that aims to use quantum properties to improve the performances of their classical counterparts. However, existing algorithms are not easily scalable due to the limitations of near-term quantum devices. Following our previous work on QDMs, here we propose and implement two physics-inspired protocols. In the first, we use the formalism of quantum stochastic walks, showing that a specific interplay of quantum and classical dynamics in the forward process produces statistically more robust models generating sets of MNIST images with lower Fr\'echet Inception Distance (FID) than using totally classical dynamics. In the second approach, we realize an algorithm to generate images by exploiting the intrinsic noise of real IBM quantum hardware with only four qubits. translated_title: 基于真实硬件噪声量子扩散的物理启发生成式人工智能模型
translated_abstract: 量子扩散模型（QDMs）是生成式人工智能中的一种新兴范式，旨在利用量子特性来提升其经典对应模型的性能。然而，由于近期量子设备的限制，现有算法难以扩展。在我们此前关于量子扩散模型工作的基础上，本文提出并实现了两种受物理启发的协议。在第一种方法中，我们采用量子随机行走的形式体系，表明正向过程中量子动力学与经典动力学的特定相互作用能够产生统计上更稳健的模型，其生成的MNIST图像集合的Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）低于完全使用经典动力学的情形。在第二种方法中，我们实现了一种算法，仅使用四个量子比特，通过利用真实IBM量子硬件的固有噪声来生成图像。我们的工作可以为大规模量子算法的新应用场景铺平道路。
tldr: 本文提出两种受物理启发的量子扩散模型方案——利用量子随机行走中量子与经典动力学的相互作用降低生成图像的FID，以及仅用四个量子比特借助真实IBM量子硬件的固有噪声生成图像——为可扩展的量子生成式AI算法开辟了新路径。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two physics-inspired quantum diffusion model protocols—one leveraging the interplay of quantum and classical dynamics in quantum stochastic walks to achieve lower FID on MNIST image generation, and another using only four qubits to exploit the intrinsic noise of real IBM quantum hardware—paving the way for scalable quantum generative AI algorithms.
